business_problem: However, their previous data architecture created bottlenecks. Upgrading to new versions was difficult, leaving the company stuck on older versions and unable to utilize new features that data practitioners requested.
solution_summary: Supercell, the creator of hits like Clash of Clans and Brawl Stars, aims to build games that are played for years and remembered forever, drawing inspiration from cross-generational franchises. To achieve this, they need to blend the art of game design with the science of hard facts. Supercell turned to the Databricks Data + AI Platform to democratize data access, simplify data processing and enable everyone from game designers to product managers to make hypothesis-driven decisions that keep nearly 300 million monthly players engaged. Supercell migrated to the Databricks Data + AI Platform to solve these infrastructure headaches. The impact was immediate: Spark and a superior notebook experience came "out of the box," resolving their core velocity issues within months. This shift allowed Supercell to focus on their broader mission: making it easy for everyone in the company to work with data.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Jobs
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and production jobs.

solution_components.name: Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines
solution_components.role: Runs declarative batch and streaming transformations with less custom pipeline code.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Coordinates ingestion and transformation workflows across the lakehouse.

data_flow: Source system and event data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables under Unity Catalog governance, with pipelines coordinated through Databricks orchestration and transformation services.
